title.en: How do customers and partners create value with us?
title.zh: 顾客和伙伴怎样和我们一起创造价值？

description.en: Why firms stopped doing everything alone, co-design versus co-production, the DART building blocks, vertical and horizontal partnerships, open innovation and lead users, with Coles and Who Gives a Crap.
description.zh: 为什么企业不再事事自己做、共同设计与共同生产、DART 构件、纵向与横向合作、开放式创新与先锋用户，案例是 Coles 和 Who Gives a Crap。

description.en: co-creation just means asking customers for feedback
description.zh: 共创就是向顾客要反馈

description.en: co-design and co-production are the same thing
description.zh: 共同设计和共同生产是一回事

title.en: Why does Coles not make everything itself?
title.zh: Coles 为什么不什么都自己做？

text.en: Coles works with more than 8,000 suppliers and, in FY26, signed new exclusive partnerships with M&S, Grill’d and Gami. It also expanded its partnership with Uber Eats for delivery. Aircraft makers went further: Boeing’s 787 was built with a global network of partners because the product had become too complex, too costly and too risky for one firm.
text.zh: Coles 与 8,000 多家供应商合作，并在 2026 财年与 M&S、Grill’d、Gami 达成新的独家合作。它还扩大了与 Uber Eats 的送货合作。飞机制造商走得更远：波音 787 由全球合作伙伴网络共同制造，因为这个产品对一家公司来说已经太复杂、太贵、风险太大。

text.en: When complexity, cost and risk rise, firms **work with others to create value**. This lesson asks **how**, and the next asks **what to keep in-house**.
text.zh: 当复杂度、成本和风险上升，企业就**与他人合作创造价值**。这节课问**怎么合作**，下一课问**什么该留在自己手里**。

prompt.en: IKEA lets you plan a kitchen online with a consultant, then delivers it in flat packs for you to assemble. How many kinds of co-creation is that?
prompt.zh: IKEA 让你在线和顾问规划厨房，然后用平板包装送货，由你自己安装。这是几种共创？

label.en: Two: co-design in the planning, co-production in the assembling
label.zh: 两种：规划时是共同设计，安装时是共同生产

label.en: One: it is all co-creation, with no difference to note
label.zh: 一种：都是共创，没有区别可说

feedback.en: The exam asks you to separate them.

label.en: None: IKEA makes the kitchen
label.zh: 没有：厨房是 IKEA 做的

feedback.en: The customer contributes in two ways.
feedback.zh: 顾客在两个方面做了贡献。

label.en: Three: co-design, co-production and co-marketing
label.zh: 三种：共同设计、共同生产和共同营销

explain.en: Co-design and co-production are two ends of a **continuum**, not two boxes. Sort six activities along it.
explain.zh: 共同设计和共同生产是**连续谱**的两端，不是两个盒子。沿着它把六种活动分一分。

text.en: Co-design and co-production describe different kinds of customer contribution. Six real or typical activities.
text.zh: 共同设计和共同生产描述的是顾客不同的贡献方式。六种真实或典型的活动。

alt.en: Six activities to place under co-design or co-production.
alt.zh: 六种活动，放到共同设计或共同生产下。

label.en: Co-design (more customer-centric)
label.zh: 共同设计（更偏顾客一侧）

label.en: Co-production (more firm-centric)
label.zh: 共同生产（更偏企业一侧）

label.en: Planning your kitchen with an online tool and a consultant
label.zh: 用在线工具和顾问规划你的厨房

why.en: The customer shapes what is made (IKEA).

label.en: Designing your own shoe online before it is made
label.zh: 先在网上设计自己的鞋，再生产

why.en: Value contributed by critiquing and designing.
why.zh: 通过评论和设计贡献价值。

label.en: A lead user builds their own solution and the firm learns from it
label.zh: 先锋用户自己做出解决方案，企业向它学习

why.en: Client-generated innovation, usually from lead users.
why.zh: 由客户产生的创新，通常来自先锋用户。

label.en: Assembling the flat-pack kitchen yourself
label.zh: 自己安装平板包装的厨房

why.en: A task the customer carries out in using the product (IKEA).
why.zh: 顾客在使用产品时承担的任务（IKEA）。

label.en: Checking in online or at a kiosk instead of at a desk
label.zh: 在网上或自助机办理登机，不去柜台

why.en: A self-service task: the customer does part of the firm’s work.
why.zh: 自助服务：顾客做了一部分企业的工作。

label.en: Scanning and bagging your own groceries at a self-checkout
label.zh: 在自助结账机上自己扫码装袋

why.en: The same logic in a supermarket.
why.zh: 同样的逻辑，发生在超市里。

done.en: **Co-design** is usually customer-centric: the customer helps decide what is made. **Co-production** is usually firm-centric: the customer carries out tasks in producing or using it. Most real cases have some of both, so say where on the continuum.
done.zh: **共同设计**通常偏顾客一侧：顾客帮助决定做什么。**共同生产**通常偏企业一侧：顾客在生产或使用中承担任务。多数真实案例两者都有，所以要说明处在连续谱的哪一段。

text.en: Prahalad and Ramaswamy’s DART model names four building blocks of co-creation. Connect each to an example (several are made-up illustrations).
text.zh: Prahalad 和 Ramaswamy 的 DART 模型给出共创的四个构件。把每个构件连到一个例子（有几个是为说明而编的）。

alt.en: Four DART building blocks to connect to examples of each.
alt.zh: 四个 DART 构件，连到各自的例子。

label.en: Dialogue
label.zh: 对话（Dialogue）

label.en: Access
label.zh: 获取（Access）

label.en: Risk-benefits
label.zh: 风险–收益（Risk-benefits）

label.en: Transparency
label.zh: 透明（Transparency）

label.en: A two-way channel where customers and staff work through a problem together (an illustration)
label.zh: 顾客和员工一起解决问题的双向渠道（举例）

label.en: Letting members use their points, the points-and-money option and the app to shape their own stay
label.zh: 让会员用积分、积分加现金选项和应用来塑造自己的住宿

label.en: Telling customers openly what a new self-service tool can go wrong with, and how the firm shares that risk (an illustration)
label.zh: 坦率告诉顾客新的自助工具可能出什么问题，以及企业怎样分担风险（举例）

label.en: Telling owners openly what their fees pay for (an illustration)
label.zh: 坦率告诉业主他们的费用花在了哪里（举例）

pairs.en: Dialogue is interactive, deep, two-way engagement.
pairs.zh: 对话是互动的、深入的、双向的参与。

pairs.en: Access is the customer reaching information, tools and experiences, not only owning a product.
pairs.zh: 获取是顾客接触信息、工具和体验，而不只是拥有产品。

pairs.en: Customers who help create value take on risk; the firm must show how it is shared.
pairs.zh: 参与创造价值的顾客要承担风险；企业必须说明怎样分担。

pairs.en: Transparency removes the gap in information that breeds distrust.
pairs.zh: 透明消除信息差，信息差会滋生不信任。

done.en: **D**ialogue, **A**ccess, **R**isk-benefits, **T**ransparency: miss one and co-creation turns into feedback collection or free labour.
done.zh: **D**ialogue 对话、**A**ccess 获取、**R**isk-benefits 风险收益、**T**ransparency 透明：缺一个，共创就变成收集反馈或者变成免费劳动。

no.en: That example shows a different building block.
no.zh: 那个例子体现的是另一个构件。

title.en: The framework, as the marker wants it

text.en: **Value co-creation** (Grönroos) is joint activity by the parties in direct interaction, aiming at value for one or both. It is only part of value formation, because the customer’s other experiences and the outcomes of those interactions also add to total value-in-use. The firm moves from **marketing to** clients to **creating value with** them: the interaction is where value is created, the client takes part in the firm’s work, and the firm tries to build the client’s expertise.
text.zh: **价值共创**（Grönroos）是各方在直接互动中的共同活动，目的是为其中一方或双方创造价值。它只是价值形成的一部分，因为顾客的其他体验和这些互动的结果同样增加总的使用价值。企业从“对顾客做营销”转向“与顾客一起创造价值”：互动是创造价值的地方，顾客参与企业的工作，企业努力提高顾客的专业能力。

items.en: **Co-design**: value contributed by critiquing, designing or using; usually more customer-centric (IKEA online kitchen planner with a consultant).
items.zh: **共同设计**：通过评论、设计或使用贡献价值；通常更偏顾客一侧（IKEA 在线厨房规划加顾问）。

items.en: **Co-production**: specific tasks customers undertake before or during use, usually self-service; more firm-centric (an IKEA kitchen delivered flat-packed; online check-in).
items.zh: **共同生产**：顾客在使用前或使用中承担的具体任务，通常是自助服务；更偏企业一侧（平板包装送货的 IKEA 厨房；在线登机）。

items.en: **Vertical** co-creation: buyers and suppliers, service providers and clients, manufacturers and sales agents or distributors (a coal miner builds a shipping terminal to suit a shipping company). **Horizontal**: with universities, or with competitors (car makers using a common platform).
items.zh: **纵向**共创：买方与供应商、服务提供者与客户、制造商与销售代理或分销商（煤矿企业建一座适合航运公司的码头）。**横向**：与大学合作，或与竞争对手合作（汽车厂共用平台）。

text.en: Relationships can encourage innovation: McDonald’s built a “living network” in which ideas from owner-operators, suppliers and design firms are filtered and tested, then spread to restaurants. **Open innovation** draws on many external sources (suppliers, clients, competitors, universities) as well as internal ones. **Lead users** are ahead of the market and often build their own solutions before products exist; firms learn from them first, then the early adopters and routine users follow. Camembert and liver: cheese makers wanted to test how ripe a cheese is by firmness without squeezing and damaging it, and liver specialists adapted the idea to measure liver stiffness without a painful biopsy: useful ideas often sit in a different field. Innovation types include new-to-the-world, incremental, disruptive or radical, platform, component and design.
text.zh: 关系可以促进创新：McDonald’s 建了一个“活的网络”，来自加盟经营者、供应商和设计公司的想法被筛选、测试，再推广到餐厅。**开放式创新**除内部来源外，还利用许多外部来源（供应商、客户、竞争对手、大学）。**先锋用户**走在市场前面，常常在产品出现之前就自己做出解决办法；企业先向他们学习，然后早期采用者和普通用户跟上。卡芒贝尔奶酪和肝脏：奶酪制造商想不挤压、不损伤地测出奶酪熟了没有（凭硬度），肝病专家把这个想法用来测肝脏硬度，免去痛苦的活检：有用的想法常常来自另一个领域。创新类型包括全新、渐进、颠覆或根本性、平台、组件和设计。

prompt.en: Take **Who Gives a Crap**, which launched through a crowdfunding campaign in 2012 (first deliveries in 2013). Write four sentences: is this co-design, co-production or something else, who co-created (customers as what?), which **DART** block it needed most, and one risk.
prompt.zh: 以 **Who Gives a Crap** 为例，它在 2012 年通过众筹发起（2013 年首批发货）。写四句话：这是共同设计、共同生产还是别的；谁参与了共创（顾客是什么角色）；它最需要哪个 **DART** 构件；以及一个风险。

key_points.en: Identifies customers as early backers who funded the product before it existed (a form of co-creation with customers, closer to co-development than co-production)
key_points.zh: 指出顾客是在产品出现前就出资的早期支持者（与顾客共创的一种，更接近共同开发而非共同生产）

key_points.en: Names a DART block and why (transparency about how funds are used; access to updates; risk-benefits for backers)
key_points.zh: 点出一个 DART 构件及原因（资金用途的透明；获取进展；支持者的风险收益）

key_points.en: Explains cause and effect: backers gave money and early trust, the firm gained funding and a first market
key_points.zh: 解释因果：支持者出钱出信任，企业得到资金和第一批市场

key_points.en: Names a risk: delay, or damaged trust
key_points.zh: 指出风险：延期，或信任受损

model_answer.en: Who Gives a Crap launched through a crowdfunding campaign in 2012, so its first customers were backers who paid before the product existed. This is co-creation with customers, nearer co-development than co-design or co-production, since they funded and shaped the launch rather than designing or doing tasks. The block it needed most was risk-benefits, because backers took the risk of paying early and the company had to show the benefit, which is why first deliveries in 2013 mattered. The cause and effect is that backers gave money and early trust, while the firm gained funding and a first market for its mission. The risk was delay or a failure to deliver, which would damage the trust the brand rests on.
model_answer.zh: Who Gives a Crap 在 2012 年通过众筹发起，所以它最早的顾客是在产品出现前就付款的支持者。这是与顾客的共创，比共同设计或共同生产更接近共同开发，因为他们出资并塑造了发布，而不是设计或做任务。它最需要的构件是风险–收益，因为支持者承担了提前付款的风险，公司必须兑现收益，这也是 2013 年首批发货至关重要的原因。因果在于：支持者给了钱和早期信任，企业得到资金和为其使命找到的第一批市场。风险是延期或无法交付，那会损害品牌所依赖的信任。

explain.en: Say who co-created what, which DART block, and the risk.
explain.zh: 说清谁共创了什么、哪个 DART 构件、风险是什么。

prompt.en:
Question. (a) Explain value co-creation, and the difference between co-design and co-production. (b) Apply the ideas to Coles in Australia. (c) Make two recommendations.

Explain (5 marks). Exceeds: precise, thorough, clear, with the right terms. Meets: accurate, key points present, a little shallow.

Write the **Explain** part.
prompt.zh:
题目。(a) 解释价值共创，以及共同设计与共同生产的区别。(b) 把这些概念应用到澳大利亚的 Coles。(c) 给出两条建议。

解释（5 分）。优秀：精确、完整、清楚，用对术语。达标：准确、要点齐全，但深度略浅。

写**解释**部分。

key_points.en: Co-creation: joint activity in direct interaction aiming at value for one or both parties (Grönroos)
key_points.zh: 共创：在直接互动中的共同活动，目的是为一方或双方创造价值（Grönroos）

key_points.en: Co-design (customer-centric, shaping what is made) versus co-production (firm-centric, customer tasks), on a continuum
key_points.zh: 共同设计（偏顾客，决定做什么）对共同生产（偏企业，顾客任务），在连续谱上

key_points.en: DART or vertical versus horizontal partnerships
key_points.zh: DART 或纵向与横向合作

key_points.en: Why: complexity, cost and risk push firms to work with others
key_points.zh: 原因：复杂度、成本和风险推动企业与他人合作

model_answer.en: Value co-creation is joint activity by parties in direct interaction, aiming at value for one or both (Grönroos). It matters because complexity, cost and risk push firms to work with customers and partners rather than do everything alone. Co-design is usually customer-centric: customers help decide what is made. Co-production is usually firm-centric: customers carry out tasks in producing or using it, such as self-service. They sit on a continuum, as in IKEA’s online planner and flat-pack assembly. Co-creation can be vertical, with buyers and suppliers, or horizontal, with competitors or universities, and works when the DART blocks of dialogue, access, risk-benefits and transparency are present.
model_answer.zh: 价值共创是各方在直接互动中的共同活动，目的是为一方或双方创造价值（Grönroos）。它重要，是因为复杂度、成本和风险促使企业与顾客和伙伴合作，而不是事事自己做。共同设计通常偏顾客：顾客帮助决定做什么。共同生产通常偏企业：顾客在生产或使用中承担任务，如自助服务。两者处在连续谱上，如 IKEA 的在线规划和平板安装。共创可以是纵向（与买方、供应商），也可以是横向（与竞争对手或大学），当对话、获取、风险收益和透明这几个 DART 构件具备时才行得通。

explain.en: Compare with the key points and the model answer. A scoring answer says the thing, shows it on this company, and stops.
explain.zh: 对照要点和参考答案。拿分的答案：把概念说准，落到这家公司上，然后收住。

prompt.en:
Question. (a) Explain value co-creation, and the difference between co-design and co-production. (b) Apply the ideas to Coles in Australia. (c) Make two recommendations.

Apply (10 marks). Exceeds: this company, rigorous cause and effect, evidence from the case. Meets: correct and logical, connections could go deeper.

Write the **Apply** part.
prompt.zh:
题目。(a) 解释价值共创，以及共同设计与共同生产的区别。(b) 把这些概念应用到澳大利亚的 Coles。(c) 给出两条建议。

应用（10 分）。优秀：针对这家公司，因果分析严密，有案例证据。达标：应用正确、逻辑通顺，但联系还可以更深。

写**应用**部分。

key_points.en: Names Coles’ co-creation partners: suppliers (8,000+), exclusive partnerships with M&S, Grill’d and Gami, Uber Eats, customers via self-checkout
key_points.zh: 指出 Coles 的共创伙伴：供应商（8,000 多家）、与 M&S、Grill’d、Gami 的独家合作、Uber Eats、通过自助结账的顾客

key_points.en: Classifies each as vertical or horizontal, co-design or co-production
key_points.zh: 把每一个归为纵向或横向、共同设计或共同生产

key_points.en: Uses true facts, including exclusive-range sales growth of 6.1% in FY26 and the expanded Uber Eats partnership
key_points.zh: 用真实事实，包括 2026 财年独家系列销售增长 6.1% 和扩大的 Uber Eats 合作

key_points.en: Explains cause and effect: why working with partners helps (reach, range, speed)
key_points.zh: 解释因果：为什么与伙伴合作有帮助（触达、品类、速度）

model_answer.en: Coles works with more than 8,000 suppliers, a vertical co-creation relationship in which suppliers shape ranges and supply. New exclusive partnerships with M&S, Grill’d and Gami are vertical co-creation too, since exclusive ranges grew sales by 6.1% in FY26: partners bring brands and food skills Coles does not hold, so shoppers get products they could not find elsewhere. Its expanded Uber Eats partnership adds a delivery partner, extending reach beyond its own fulfilment centres. Shoppers co-produce when they scan and pack at self-checkouts, which moves a task to the customer. The common cause and effect is that each partner supplies a capability Coles would find costly or slow to build alone.
model_answer.zh: Coles 与 8,000 多家供应商合作，这是一种纵向共创关系，供应商参与塑造品类和供货。与 M&S、Grill’d 和 Gami 的新独家合作也是纵向共创，因为独家系列在 2026 财年带来了 6.1% 的销售增长：伙伴带来了 Coles 不具备的品牌和食品技能，所以购物者能买到别处买不到的东西。扩大的 Uber Eats 合作增加了一个配送伙伴，把触达延伸到自有履约中心之外。购物者在自助结账机上扫码装袋时参与共同生产，这把一项任务转给了顾客。共同的因果是：每个伙伴都提供一项 Coles 独自建设会很贵或很慢的能力。

explain.en: Compare with the key points and the model answer. A scoring answer says the thing, shows it on this company, and stops.
explain.zh: 对照要点和参考答案。拿分的答案：把概念说准，落到这家公司上，然后收住。

prompt.en:
Question. (a) Explain value co-creation, and the difference between co-design and co-production. (b) Apply the ideas to Coles in Australia. (c) Make two recommendations.

Recommend (5 marks). Exceeds: exactly two, realistic, strategic, actionable, each following from your analysis, with a risk named. Meets: sound but thin on how.

Write the **Recommend** part: exactly two.
prompt.zh:
题目。(a) 解释价值共创，以及共同设计与共同生产的区别。(b) 把这些概念应用到澳大利亚的 Coles。(c) 给出两条建议。

建议（5 分）。优秀：恰好两条，现实、有战略性、可执行，都从你的分析里推出来，并点出风险。达标：合理，但“怎么做”偏薄。

写**建议**部分：恰好两条。

key_points.en: Exactly two from the analysis (strengthen transparency with partners; learn from lead users)
key_points.zh: 恰好两条，从分析里推出（加强与伙伴的透明；向先锋用户学习）

model_answer.en: First, share sales and feedback data with exclusive partners on a regular schedule, because transparency is the DART block that keeps joint ranges improving. The risk is leaking commercial data, so share only what each range needs. Second, invite a small group of the most active online shoppers to test new services before launch, because lead users spot needs early and Coles’ online business is growing fast. The risk is spending effort on unrepresentative views, so test ideas widely afterwards.
model_answer.zh: 第一，定期与独家合作伙伴共享销售和反馈数据，因为透明是让联合品类持续改进的 DART 构件。风险是泄露商业数据，所以只共享每个品类所需的。第二，邀请一小群最活跃的线上购物者在新服务上线前试用，因为先锋用户能较早发现需求，而 Coles 的线上业务增长很快。风险是在不具代表性的意见上花力气，所以之后要广泛测试这些想法。

explain.en: Compare with the key points and the model answer. A scoring answer says the thing, shows it on this company, and stops.
explain.zh: 对照要点和参考答案。拿分的答案：把概念说准，落到这家公司上，然后收住。
